# Kernel Utilization Distribution Probability {.tabset}

**Regla de Silverman**

$h = \sigma n^{-1/6}$

donde: 

$\sigma^2 = 0.5(\text{var}(x) + \text{var}(y))$

El ancho de banda (h) es proporcional a la desviación estándar (σ) de los datos y varía inversamente con la raíz sexta del tamaño de la muestra (n). 

Cuanto mayor sea la desviación estándar de los datos y menor sea el tamaño de la muestra, menor será el valor h.

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(raster)
library(sp)
library(adehabitatHR)
library(sf)

var <- raster("E:/5_Curso_ENM/2025/P_5/bio1.tif")
r <- rasterToPoints(var)
r1 <- SpatialPoints(r[, 1:2])
r2 <- SpatialPixels(r1)

den <- occ[, c(1, 2)]
den <- SpatialPoints(den)

kde <- kernelUD(den, grid = r2, h = "href")

k <- raster(kde)
kp <- rasterToPoints(k)
ksf <- st_as_sf(as.data.frame(kp), coords = c("x", "y"), crs = st_crs("+datum=WGS84 +proj=longlat"))
kr <- raster(crs = crs(ksf), vals = 0, resolution = res(var)) %>% rasterize(ksf, .)

a <- crop(kr[[2]], var)
b <- mask(a, var)

```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(viridis)
colors <- viridis(4)

den_map <- leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addRasterImage(b, opacity = 0.5, colors = colorNumeric(c("transparent", colors[1], colors[2], colors[3], colors[4]), values(b), na.color = "transparent")) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = occ, ~decimalLongitude, ~decimalLatitude, radius = 1, color = "grey", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.2)

den_map

```

# Gausian Kernel Density / Rule-of-thumb

$f(x,y) = \frac {\sum_{s} \phi (({x - x_s}) /{h_x}) \phi (({y - y_s}) /{h_y})}{nh_xh_y}$

Donde:

ϕ = función de densidad en una distribución gausiana normal, no es negativa e integra a 1.

$H = (Q3-Q1) / 1.34$

$IQR = (2 * z) * σ$

$(2*0.674) ≈ \frac{IQR} {σ}$

$1.34 ≈ \frac{IQR} {σ}$

Para el rango intercuartilico (del 25% al 75%) z = 0.674, Entonces si se supone una distribución normal, es una constante de 1.34


# Geographic sampling biases - Bayesian framework

https://nsojournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/ecog.05102?fbclid=IwAR2soRZ04nyu6_xFXcwedPd_uhv6bqP-vopJdk9UGpH0GuAcEvfYK8EnZoo

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

knitr::include_graphics("E:/5_Curso_ENM/2025/P_5/samp.png")

```

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(terra)
#install.packages("devtools")
#library(devtools)
#install_github("azizka/sampbias")
library(sampbias)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(patchwork)

occ$species <- "Reptiles"
occ_b <- as.data.frame(occ[, c(4, 1, 2)])

var2 <- rast("E:/5_Curso_ENM/2025/P_5/bio1.tif")
wgs84 <- "+proj=longlat +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
terra::crs(var2) <- wgs84
res <- res(var2)[1]

air <- terra::vect("E:/5_Curso_ENM/2025/P_5/gaz/ne_10m_airports.shp")
air <- crop(air, var2)
air <- vect(geom(air)[, c("x", "y")])

cit <- terra::vect("E:/5_Curso_ENM/2025/P_5/gaz/ne_10m_urban_areas.shp")
cit <- crop(cit, var2)
cit <- vect(geom(cit)[, c("x", "y")])

roa <- terra::vect("E:/5_Curso_ENM/2025/P_5/gaz/ne_10m_roads.shp")
roa <- crop(roa, var2)
roa <- vect(geom(roa))

gazetteers <- list(airports = air, cities = cit, roads = roa)

time_taken <- system.time({
  bay <- calculate_bias(x = occ_b, gaz = gazetteers, res = res, inp_raster = var2, buffer = 0)
})

time_taken[[3]]/60

head(bay$bias_estimate)

plo1 <-  bay$bias_estimate %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("w_"), names_to = "bias",
                 values_to = "posterior_estimate") %>%
    mutate(bias = gsub("w_", "", .data$bias)) %>%
    mutate(bias = fct_reorder(.data$bias, .data$posterior_estimate, .fun = median, .desc = FALSE))

head(plo1)

proj <- project_bias(bay)
result <- map_bias(proj, type = "log_sampling_rate")

proj <- raster(proj[[2]])
var <- crop(var, proj)
proj <- crop(proj, var)
pr <- mask(proj, var)

p1 <- ggplot(plo1)+
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = .data$bias, y = .data$posterior_estimate, fill = .data$bias))+
    scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE)+
    xlab("Biasing factor")+
    ylab("Posterior weight")+
    coord_flip()+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")

p1

```

# Generar y guardar puntos de background {.tabset}

**n depende de la cantidad de datos que necesites y del area**

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0304380023003344

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

knitr::include_graphics("E:/5_Curso_ENM/2025/P_5/backg.png")

```

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

#library(remotes)
# remotes::install_github("sjevelazco/flexsdm")
library(flexsdm)
library(dplyr)

# b - Kernel utilization
# bl = Gausian RT
# pr = Bayesian

ncell(b)

bg_ku <- sample_background(
  data = occ,
  x = "decimalLongitude",
  y = "decimalLatitude",
  n = 1000,
  method = "biased",
  rlayer = var,
  rbias = b
)

bg_kr <- sample_background(
  data = occ,
  x = "decimalLongitude",
  y = "decimalLatitude",
  n = 1000,
  method = "biased",
  rlayer = var,
  rbias = bl
)

bg_b <- sample_background(
  data = occ,
  x = "decimalLongitude",
  y = "decimalLatitude",
  n = 1000,
  method = "biased",
  rlayer = var,
  rbias = pr
)

```


```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

all <- leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addRasterImage(b, opacity = 0.5, colors = colorNumeric(c("transparent", colors), values(b), na.color = "transparent"), group = "KU") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = bg_ku, ~decimalLongitude, ~decimalLatitude, radius = 1, color = "grey50", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, group = "KU Points") %>%
  addRasterImage(bl, opacity = 0.5, colors = colorNumeric(c("transparent", colors), values(bl), na.color = "transparent"), group = "KR") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = bg_kr, ~decimalLongitude, ~decimalLatitude, radius = 1, color = "grey50", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, group = "KR Points") %>%
  addRasterImage(pr, opacity = 0.5, colors = colorNumeric(c("transparent", colors), values(pr), na.color = "transparent"), group = "Bayes") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = bg_b, ~decimalLongitude, ~decimalLatitude, radius = 1, color = "grey50", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8, group = "Bayes Points") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = occ, ~decimalLongitude, ~decimalLatitude, radius = 1, color = "grey", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.5, group = "Base points") %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("KU", "KR", "Bayes"),
    overlayGroups = c("Base points", "KU Points", "KR Points", "Bayes Points"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

all

```
